releases.name: v1.1.0 — audit-driven rewrite
releases.body:
Major rewrite after a full code audit. **Breaking: none** — all changes are backwards-compatible additions and bug fixes.

## Critical bug fixes

- **`backupDir` setting now honoured everywhere** — previously hardcoded to `DEFAULT_BACKUP_DIR`; users who configured a custom backup directory silently had backups written to the wrong location.
- **`sm_restore force=true` is now safe** — a safety backup of the existing session is created automatically *before* deletion. If the subsequent import fails, the user still has a recovery file. Previously the original was deleted first and could be lost irreversibly.
- **`sm_full_backup` now finds the plugin on npm-installs** — searches local-dev + three npm-cache layouts. Previously it only looked at `~/.config/opencode/plugins/session-manager.ts`, which does not exist for end users who installed via the `plugin[]` array.
- **Removed `truncateId()`** — the helper was hiding full session IDs from the agent (`ses_060358f5...`), making subsequent tool calls fail with "Session not found".

## P0 — current session support

- New hook `tool.execute.before` captures `currentSessionId` in-memory on every tool call.
- `sm_pin` / `sm_unpin` / `sm_backup`: `sessionId` is now **optional** — defaults to the current session. "Pin this session" finally works in one call.
- New tool `sm_current_session` for introspection.
- `sm_pin` now updates the note on an already-pinned session instead of returning "Already pinned".

## P1 — quality of life

- **`findSessionByQuery`** — git-like prefix matching (≥4 chars). Distinguishes `found` / `not_found` / `ambiguous` / `error` (the previous `findSessionById` swallowed all errors as `null`).
- **`sm_list`** — `scope: pinned | recent | all` (default `pinned`).
- **New tool `sm_list_backups`** — enumerate backup files with metadata (filename, session, title, date, corrupt flag).
- **`sm_cleanup` / `sm_cleanup_backups`** — `dry_run=true` by default. Destructive operations now require explicit `dry_run=false`.
- **`sm_search`** — `search_in: title | title+note`, capped at 50 results to avoid OOM on large session DBs.

## Refactor — modular structure

`session-manager.ts` shrank from 1293 to 646 lines (-50%). Logic moved into focused modules:

| Module | Responsibility |
|---|---|
| `src/state.ts` | paths + `loadStateDefault` / `saveStateDefault` / `getBackupDir` / `logHookEvent` |
| `src/types.ts` | shared interfaces |
| `src/format.ts` | pure helpers (`formatDate`, `findPluginSourcePath`) |
| `src/cli.ts` | opencode CLI wrappers + `findSessionByQuery` + `searchSessions` |
| `src/backup.ts` | backup / cleanup / retention / restore / full-backup |

## Quality

- `tsconfig.json`: **`strict: true`** + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess: true`.
- `package.json`: new `typecheck` script; `prepublishOnly` now runs `typecheck && test && build`.
- **GitHub Actions CI**: `typecheck + test + build` on every push/PR.
- Tests: `afterAll` cleanup for `.tmp-test-*` artifacts (was leaving 5+ dirs in the working tree).
- `install.sh`: `rm -rf dist/` before `cp -r` — fixes a bug where repeated installs created a nested `dist/dist/` and left opencode loading a stale `plugin.js`.
- Diagnostic log: hook invocations are logged to `~/.local/share/opencode/session-manager-hooks.log` to verify whether opencode actually fires `session.idle` / `session.deleted`.

## Stats

13 files changed, +1201 / −566 lines. 22 tests pass, typecheck clean.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EnerJizeIT/opencode-session-manager/compare/v1.0.7...v1.1.0

releases.name: v1.0.7 — OpenCode Session Manager
releases.body:
## Pin, back up & restore your opencode AI sessions

Never lose a valuable AI conversation again. This plugin adds **12 tools + 2 hooks** to opencode for session management — all through natural language.

### Features
- 📌 **Pin/unpin** — protect important sessions from cleanup
- 💾 **Backup** — individual or all pinned sessions (JSON, survives reinstalls)
- ♻️ **Restore** — bring a session back from backup
- 🧹 **Auto-cleanup** — old sessions backed up then deleted (pinned always safe)
- 🔍 **Search** — find sessions by title
- ⚙️ **Configurable** — cleanup/retention settings, set and forget

### Install
```jsonc
// ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json
{ "plugin": ["@enerjizeit/opencode-session-manager"] }
```

### Links
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@enerjizeit/opencode-session-manager
- Usage: https://github.com/EnerJizeIT/opencode-session-manager/blob/master/USAGE.md
